/* ============================================================
   TRAVEL SAFE INTERNATIONAL (TSI) — FULL DATABASE CREATION
   Platform: Microsoft SQL Server
   Creates: Database + All Tables + PK/FK/Checks + Key Indexes
   Run this WHOLE script in one go.
   ============================================================ */

SET NOCOUNT ON;
GO

/* 1) Create DB */
IF DB_ID('TSI_TravelSafe') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    ALTER DATABASE TSI_TravelSafe SET SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE;
    DROP DATABASE TSI_TravelSafe;
END
GO

CREATE DATABASE TSI_TravelSafe;
GO

USE TSI_TravelSafe;
GO

/* 2) Safety: use dbo schema */
IF SCHEMA_ID('dbo') IS NULL EXEC('CREATE SCHEMA dbo');
GO

/* ============================================================
   A) Reference + Location
   ============================================================ */

CREATE TABLE dbo.Country (
    CountryID        INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    CountryName      NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.City (
    CityID       INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    CityCode     NVARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- e.g., "KTM"
    CityName     NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    CountryID    INT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_City_Country
        FOREIGN KEY (CountryID) REFERENCES dbo.Country(CountryID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.Airport (
    AirportID     INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    AirportCode   NVARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL UNIQUE, -- IATA
    AirportName   NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    CityID        INT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Airport_City
        FOREIGN KEY (CityID) REFERENCES dbo.City(CityID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.CabinClass (
    ClassCode   CHAR(1) PRIMARY KEY, -- F/J/Y
    ClassName   NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    CONSTRAINT CK_CabinClass_Code CHECK (ClassCode IN ('F','J','Y'))
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.ReservationStatus (
    StatusCode          NVARCHAR(20) PRIMARY KEY,  -- HOLD/BOOKED/TICKETED/CANCELLED/FLOWN/CHANGED
    StatusDescription   NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.AgeCategory (
    AgeCatCode  CHAR(3) PRIMARY KEY, -- INF/CHD/ADT/SNR
    MinAge      INT NOT NULL,
    MaxAge      INT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT CK_AgeCat_Code CHECK (AgeCatCode IN ('INF','CHD','ADT','SNR')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_AgeCat_Min CHECK (MinAge >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_AgeCat_Range CHECK (MaxAge IS NULL OR MaxAge >= MinAge)
);
GO

/* ============================================================
   B) Airline Ops
   ============================================================ */

CREATE TABLE dbo.Airline (
    AirlineID               INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    AirlineCode             NVARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL UNIQUE, -- e.g. "SQ"
    AirlineName             NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    HQCountryID             INT NULL,
    MaxPassengersPerBooking INT NULL, -- some airlines cap at 10; NULL = no cap
    AllowWheelchair         BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Airline_Wheel DEFAULT (1),
    AllowUMNR               BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Airline_UMNR  DEFAULT (1),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Airline_MaxPax CHECK (MaxPassengersPerBooking IS NULL OR MaxPassengersPerBooking BETWEEN 1 AND 99),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Airline_HQCountry FOREIGN KEY (HQCountryID) REFERENCES dbo.Country(CountryID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.Aircraft (
    AircraftID     INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    AirlineID      INT NOT NULL,
    AircraftCode   NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, -- used in revenue query
    Model          NVARCHAR(60) NULL,
    TotalSeats     INT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT UQ_Aircraft_AirlineCode UNIQUE (AirlineID, AircraftCode),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Aircraft_TotalSeats CHECK (TotalSeats > 0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Aircraft_Airline FOREIGN KEY (AirlineID) REFERENCES dbo.Airline(AirlineID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.AircraftSeatConfig (
    AircraftID     INT NOT NULL,
    ClassCode      CHAR(1) NOT NULL,
    SeatCapacity   INT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT PK_AircraftSeatConfig PRIMARY KEY (AircraftID, ClassCode),
    CONSTRAINT CK_AircraftSeatConfig_Cap CHECK (SeatCapacity >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_AircraftSeatConfig_Aircraft FOREIGN KEY (AircraftID) REFERENCES dbo.Aircraft(AircraftID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_AircraftSeatConfig_Class FOREIGN KEY (ClassCode) REFERENCES dbo.CabinClass(ClassCode)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.FlightRoute (
    RouteID              INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    AirlineID            INT NOT NULL,
    FlightNumber         NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, -- e.g. "SQ212"
    OriginAirportID      INT NOT NULL,
    DestinationAirportID INT NOT NULL,
    StdDurationMinutes   INT NOT NULL,
    IsActive             BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Route_Active DEFAULT (1),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_Route_AirlineFlight UNIQUE (AirlineID, FlightNumber),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Route_Duration CHECK (StdDurationMinutes > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Route_OriginDest CHECK (OriginAirportID <> DestinationAirportID),

CONSTRAINT CK_Route_Duration CHECK (StdDurationMinutes > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Route_OriginDest CHECK (OriginAirportID <> DestinationAirportID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Route_Airline FOREIGN KEY (AirlineID) REFERENCES dbo.Airline(AirlineID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Route_OriginAirport FOREIGN KEY (OriginAirportID) REFERENCES dbo.Airport(AirportID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Route_DestAirport FOREIGN KEY (DestinationAirportID) REFERENCES dbo.Airport(AirportID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.FlightJourney (
    JourneyID          INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    RouteID            INT NOT NULL,
    AircraftID         INT NOT NULL,
    JourneyDate        DATE NOT NULL,
    DepartureDateTime  DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL,
    ArrivalDateTime    DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL,
    JourneyStatus      NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Journey_Status DEFAULT ('Scheduled'),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Journey_Time CHECK (ArrivalDateTime > DepartureDateTime),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Journey_Status CHECK (JourneyStatus IN ('Scheduled','Departed','Cancelled','Arrived')),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Journey_Route FOREIGN KEY (RouteID) REFERENCES dbo.FlightRoute(RouteID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Journey_Aircraft FOREIGN KEY (AircraftID) REFERENCES dbo.Aircraft(AircraftID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.JourneySeatInventory (
    JourneyID     INT NOT NULL,
    ClassCode     CHAR(1) NOT NULL,
    SeatsTotal    INT NOT NULL,
    SeatsBooked   INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Inv_Booked DEFAULT (0),
    CONSTRAINT PK_JourneySeatInventory PRIMARY KEY (JourneyID, ClassCode),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Inv_Seats CHECK (SeatsTotal >= 0 AND SeatsBooked >= 0 AND SeatsBooked <= SeatsTotal),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Inv_Journey FOREIGN KEY (JourneyID) REFERENCES dbo.FlightJourney(JourneyID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Inv_Class FOREIGN KEY (ClassCode) REFERENCES dbo.CabinClass(ClassCode)
);
GO

/* ============================================================
   C) Fare + Services + Meals
   ============================================================ */

CREATE TABLE dbo.FareBase (
    FareBaseID      INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    RouteID         INT NOT NULL,
    ClassCode       CHAR(1) NOT NULL,
    AdultBaseFare   DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
    CurrencyCode    CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT UQ_FareBase_RouteClass UNIQUE (RouteID, ClassCode),
    CONSTRAINT CK_FareBase_Adult CHECK (AdultBaseFare >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_FareBase_Route FOREIGN KEY (RouteID) REFERENCES dbo.FlightRoute(RouteID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_FareBase_Class FOREIGN KEY (ClassCode) REFERENCES dbo.CabinClass(ClassCode)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.FareRule (
    FareRuleID             INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    AirlineID              INT NOT NULL,
    AgeCatCode             CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
    RuleType               NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, -- PERCENT_OF_ADULT / FIXED etc.
    PercentMin             DECIMAL(5,2) NULL,
    PercentMax             DECIMAL(5,2) NULL,
    AppliesWhenInfantInLap BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_FareRule_Lap  DEFAULT (0),
    AppliesWhenInfantInSeat BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_FareRule_Seat DEFAULT (0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_FareRule_Airline FOREIGN KEY (AirlineID) REFERENCES dbo.Airline(AirlineID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_FareRule_AgeCat FOREIGN KEY (AgeCatCode) REFERENCES dbo.AgeCategory(AgeCatCode),
    CONSTRAINT CK_FareRule_Percent CHECK (
        (PercentMin IS NULL AND PercentMax IS NULL)
        OR (PercentMin IS NOT NULL AND PercentMax IS NOT NULL AND PercentMin >= 0 AND PercentMax >= PercentMin)
    )
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.ServiceType (
    ServiceTypeID   INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    ServiceCode     NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL UNIQUE, -- UMNR/WCHR/CHCARE
    ServiceName     NVARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    Description     NVARCHAR(200) NULL
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.AirlineServicePolicy (
    AirlineID        INT NOT NULL,
    ServiceTypeID    INT NOT NULL,
    MinAge           INT NULL,
    MaxAge           INT NULL,
    MandatoryMinAge  INT NULL,
    MandatoryMaxAge  INT NULL,
    ServiceFee       DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Policy_Fee DEFAULT (0),
    CONSTRAINT PK_AirlineServicePolicy PRIMARY KEY (AirlineID, ServiceTypeID),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Policy_Ages CHECK (
        (MinAge IS NULL OR MinAge >= 0) AND
        (MaxAge IS NULL OR MaxAge >= 0) AND
        (MandatoryMinAge IS NULL OR MandatoryMinAge >= 0) AND
        (MandatoryMaxAge IS NULL OR MandatoryMaxAge >= 0) AND
        (MaxAge IS NULL OR MinAge IS NULL OR MaxAge >= MinAge) AND
        (MandatoryMaxAge IS NULL OR MandatoryMinAge IS NULL OR MandatoryMaxAge >= MandatoryMinAge)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Policy_Fee CHECK (ServiceFee >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Policy_Airline FOREIGN KEY (AirlineID) REFERENCES dbo.Airline(AirlineID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Policy_ServiceType FOREIGN KEY (ServiceTypeID) REFERENCES dbo.ServiceType(ServiceTypeID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.MealType (
    MealTypeID     INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

CONSTRAINT FK_Policy_ServiceType FOREIGN KEY (ServiceTypeID) REFERENCES dbo.ServiceType(ServiceTypeID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.MealType (
    MealTypeID     INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    MealTypeName   NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL UNIQUE -- Vegetarian/Non-Vegetarian etc.
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.Meal (
    MealID        INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    MealCode      NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    MealName      NVARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    MealTypeID    INT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT FK_Meal_MealType FOREIGN KEY (MealTypeID) REFERENCES dbo.MealType(MealTypeID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.FlightMealOffering (
    JourneyID            INT NOT NULL,
    MealID               INT NOT NULL,
    IsChildSpecialMeal   BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Offer_Child DEFAULT (0),
    ServingType          NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, -- Refreshment/SingleMeal/MultiMeal
    CONSTRAINT PK_FlightMealOffering PRIMARY KEY (JourneyID, MealID),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Offer_Serving CHECK (ServingType IN ('Refreshment','SingleMeal','MultiMeal')),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Offer_Journey FOREIGN KEY (JourneyID) REFERENCES dbo.FlightJourney(JourneyID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Offer_Meal FOREIGN KEY (MealID) REFERENCES dbo.Meal(MealID)
);
GO

/* ============================================================
   D) Booking + Travelers + Segments
   ============================================================ */

CREATE TABLE dbo.Booking (
    BookingID          INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    PNR                NVARCHAR(12) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    BookingType        NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, -- OneWay/RoundTrip/MultiCity
    BookedAt           DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Booking_BookedAt DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
    BookingStatusCode  NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    TotalAmountPaid    DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Booking_Total DEFAULT (0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Booking_Type CHECK (BookingType IN ('OneWay','RoundTrip','MultiCity')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Booking_Total CHECK (TotalAmountPaid >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Booking_Status FOREIGN KEY (BookingStatusCode) REFERENCES dbo.ReservationStatus(StatusCode)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.Traveler (
    TravelerID      INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    PassportNo      NVARCHAR(30) NULL UNIQUE,
    FirstName       NVARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    LastName        NVARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    DateOfBirth     DATE NOT NULL,
    Gender          NVARCHAR(10) NULL,
    Phone           NVARCHAR(30) NULL,
    Email           NVARCHAR(120) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT CK_Traveler_DOB CHECK (DateOfBirth <= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.BookingTraveler (
    BookingTravelerID   INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    BookingID           INT NOT NULL,
    TravelerID          INT NOT NULL,
    TravelerNo          INT NOT NULL, -- 1..n inside booking
    IsPrimaryContact    BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_BT_Primary DEFAULT (0),
    IsAccompanied       BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_BT_Accomp DEFAULT (1),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_BT_BookingTraveler UNIQUE (BookingID, TravelerID),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_BT_BookingTravelerNo UNIQUE (BookingID, TravelerNo),
    CONSTRAINT CK_BT_TravelerNo CHECK (TravelerNo > 0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_BT_Booking FOREIGN KEY (BookingID) REFERENCES dbo.Booking(BookingID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_BT_Traveler FOREIGN KEY (TravelerID) REFERENCES dbo.Traveler(TravelerID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.BookingSegment (
    SegmentID          INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    BookingID          INT NOT NULL,
    SegmentSeq         INT NOT NULL,
    JourneyID          INT NOT NULL,
    FromAirportID      INT NOT NULL,
    ToAirportID        INT NOT NULL,
    SegmentStatusCode  NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT UQ_Segment_Seq UNIQUE (BookingID, SegmentSeq),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Segment_Seq CHECK (SegmentSeq > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Segment_FromTo CHECK (FromAirportID <> ToAirportID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Segment_Booking FOREIGN KEY (BookingID) REFERENCES dbo.Booking(BookingID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Segment_Journey FOREIGN KEY (JourneyID) REFERENCES dbo.FlightJourney(JourneyID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Segment_FromAirport FOREIGN KEY (FromAirportID) REFERENCES dbo.Airport(AirportID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Segment_ToAirport FOREIGN KEY (ToAirportID) REFERENCES dbo.Airport(AirportID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Segment_Status FOREIGN KEY (SegmentStatusCode) REFERENCES dbo.ReservationStatus(StatusCode)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.TravelerSegment (
    TravelerSegmentID   INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    SegmentID           INT NOT NULL,
    BookingTravelerID   INT NOT NULL,
    ClassCode           CHAR(1) NOT NULL,
    SeatNo              NVARCHAR(10) NULL,
    AgeAtTravel         INT NOT NULL,
    AgeCatCode          CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
    InfantTravelMode    NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_TS_InfMode DEFAULT ('NONE'), -- IN_LAP/IN_SEAT/NONE
    BaseFare            DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_TS_Base DEFAULT (0),

InfantTravelMode    NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_TS_InfMode DEFAULT ('NONE'), -- IN_LAP/IN_SEAT/NONE
    BaseFare            DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_TS_Base DEFAULT (0),
    Taxes               DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_TS_Tax DEFAULT (0),
    ServiceFees         DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_TS_Svc DEFAULT (0),
    BaggageFees         DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_TS_Bag DEFAULT (0),
    FinalSegmentPrice   AS (BaseFare + Taxes + ServiceFees + BaggageFees) PERSISTED,
    CONSTRAINT CK_TS_Age CHECK (AgeAtTravel >= 0 AND AgeAtTravel <= 120),
    CONSTRAINT CK_TS_InfMode CHECK (InfantTravelMode IN ('IN_LAP','IN_SEAT','NONE')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_TS_Money CHECK (BaseFare >= 0 AND Taxes >= 0 AND ServiceFees >= 0 AND BaggageFees >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_TS_Segment FOREIGN KEY (SegmentID) REFERENCES dbo.BookingSegment(SegmentID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_TS_BookingTraveler FOREIGN KEY (BookingTravelerID) REFERENCES dbo.BookingTraveler(BookingTravelerID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_TS_Class FOREIGN KEY (ClassCode) REFERENCES dbo.CabinClass(ClassCode),
    CONSTRAINT FK_TS_AgeCat FOREIGN KEY (AgeCatCode) REFERENCES dbo.AgeCategory(AgeCatCode),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_TS_OnePerPaxPerSeg UNIQUE (SegmentID, BookingTravelerID)
);
GO

/* Meal request per traveler per segment */
CREATE TABLE dbo.MealRequest (
    MealRequestID        INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    TravelerSegmentID    INT NOT NULL,
    MealID               INT NOT NULL,
    RequestedAt          DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MR_ReqAt DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_MR_TravelerSeg UNIQUE (TravelerSegmentID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_MR_TravelerSegment FOREIGN KEY (TravelerSegmentID) REFERENCES dbo.TravelerSegment(TravelerSegmentID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_MR_Meal FOREIGN KEY (MealID) REFERENCES dbo.Meal(MealID)
);
GO

/* ============================================================
   E) Baggage + SSR
   ============================================================ */

CREATE TABLE dbo.BaggagePurchase (
    BaggagePurchaseID  INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    TravelerSegmentID  INT NOT NULL,
    ExtraBagsCount     INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_BP_Bags DEFAULT (0),
    ExtraWeightKg      INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_BP_Kg   DEFAULT (0),
    FeeAmount          DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_BP_Fee DEFAULT (0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_BP CHECK (ExtraBagsCount >= 0 AND ExtraWeightKg >= 0 AND FeeAmount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_BP_TravelerSegment FOREIGN KEY (TravelerSegmentID) REFERENCES dbo.TravelerSegment(TravelerSegmentID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.SpecialServiceRequest (
    SSR_ID           INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    TravelerSegmentID INT NOT NULL,
    ServiceTypeID    INT NOT NULL,
    IsMandatoryApplied BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_SSR_Mand DEFAULT (0),
    FeeAmount        DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_SSR_Fee DEFAULT (0),
    Notes            NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT CK_SSR_Fee CHECK (FeeAmount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_SSR_TravelerSegment FOREIGN KEY (TravelerSegmentID) REFERENCES dbo.TravelerSegment(TravelerSegmentID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_SSR_ServiceType FOREIGN KEY (ServiceTypeID) REFERENCES dbo.ServiceType(ServiceTypeID),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_SSR_Once UNIQUE (TravelerSegmentID, ServiceTypeID)
);
GO

/* ============================================================
   F) Payment + Cancellation + Credits + Reschedule
   ============================================================ */

CREATE TABLE dbo.PaymentTransaction (
    PaymentID       INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    BookingID       INT NOT NULL,
    PaidAt          DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Pay_PaidAt DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
    Amount          DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
    PaymentMethod   NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    PaymentStatus   NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT CK_Pay_Amount CHECK (Amount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Pay_Status CHECK (PaymentStatus IN ('Pending','Success','Failed','Refunded')),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Pay_Booking FOREIGN KEY (BookingID) REFERENCES dbo.Booking(BookingID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.Cancellation (
    CancellationID        INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    SegmentID             INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    CancelledAt           DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Can_At DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
    Reason                NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
    WasWithin24Hours      BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Can_24 DEFAULT (0),
    CreditEligibleAmount  DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Can_Credit DEFAULT (0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Can_Eligible CHECK (CreditEligibleAmount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Can_Segment FOREIGN KEY (SegmentID) REFERENCES dbo.BookingSegment(SegmentID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.CreditWallet (
    CreditWalletID              INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    TravelerID                  INT NOT NULL,
    CreatedFromCancellationID   INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    CreditAmount                DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,

TravelerID                  INT NOT NULL,
    CreatedFromCancellationID   INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    CreditAmount                DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
    ValidFrom                   DATE NOT NULL,
    ValidUntil                  DATE NOT NULL,
    RemainingAmount             DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT CK_CW_Amounts CHECK (CreditAmount >= 0 AND RemainingAmount >= 0 AND RemainingAmount <= CreditAmount),
    CONSTRAINT CK_CW_Valid CHECK (ValidUntil >= ValidFrom),
    CONSTRAINT FK_CW_Traveler FOREIGN KEY (TravelerID) REFERENCES dbo.Traveler(TravelerID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_CW_Cancellation FOREIGN KEY (CreatedFromCancellationID) REFERENCES dbo.Cancellation(CancellationID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.CreditUsage (
    CreditUsageID     INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    CreditWalletID    INT NOT NULL,
    BookingID         INT NOT NULL,
    UsedAmount        DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
    UsedAt            DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_CU_At DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
    CONSTRAINT CK_CU_Used CHECK (UsedAmount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_CU_Wallet FOREIGN KEY (CreditWalletID) REFERENCES dbo.CreditWallet(CreditWalletID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_CU_Booking FOREIGN KEY (BookingID) REFERENCES dbo.Booking(BookingID)
);
GO

CREATE TABLE dbo.RescheduleChange (
    ChangeID         INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    SegmentID        INT NOT NULL,
    OldJourneyID     INT NOT NULL,
    NewJourneyID     INT NOT NULL,
    ChangedAt        DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_RC_At DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
    ChangeFee        DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_RC_Fee DEFAULT (0),
    WasWithin24Hours BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_RC_24 DEFAULT (0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_RC_Fee CHECK (ChangeFee >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_RC_OldNew CHECK (OldJourneyID <> NewJourneyID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_RC_Segment FOREIGN KEY (SegmentID) REFERENCES dbo.BookingSegment(SegmentID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_RC_OldJourney FOREIGN KEY (OldJourneyID) REFERENCES dbo.FlightJourney(JourneyID),
    CONSTRAINT FK_RC_NewJourney FOREIGN KEY (NewJourneyID) REFERENCES dbo.FlightJourney(JourneyID)
);
GO

/* ============================================================
   G) Helpful Indexes (for assignment queries)
   ============================================================ */

CREATE INDEX IX_Journey_RouteDate
ON dbo.FlightJourney (RouteID, JourneyDate);
GO

CREATE INDEX IX_Route_OriginDest
ON dbo.FlightRoute (OriginAirportID, DestinationAirportID, AirlineID);
GO

CREATE INDEX IX_Segment_Journey
ON dbo.BookingSegment (JourneyID, SegmentStatusCode);
GO

CREATE INDEX IX_TS_SegmentClass
ON dbo.TravelerSegment (SegmentID, ClassCode, AgeCatCode);
GO

CREATE INDEX IX_MealRequest_Meal
ON dbo.MealRequest (MealID);
GO
